evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Current literature evaluates large language models (LLMs) on multilingual kinship understanding using multiple choice benchmarks, treating it as a recognition problem.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On explicitly specified L3 prompts, accuracy varies sharply, from GLM-5.1 at 72.29% to Llama-3.370B at 24.24%.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We instead prompt five open weight LLMs to generate kinship terms in three non Western languages (Hindi, Tamil, and Korean) across two communicative tasks and pair this with a matched option-supported selection baseline.
